resources.string: Connecting to Wine. Wait for the environment to finish starting.
The Wine helper did not respond. Use Reconnect after the environment starts. This Wine version may not support the bridge.
Not connected or another command is pending. Try again after connecting.
Command completed. Read the updated window to check the result.
The application could not perform this action. Try focusing the control and using Windows keys.
The Windows interface changed. Read the updated controls and try again.
This action or text is not supported.

These controls come from the active Wine window. Double-tap to activate or edit. Use the long-press action to focus a control before sending keys. Application text stays in its original language. Password content is hidden.
No readable controls were found in the active window. Choose another window or open the Windows accessibility test. Custom-drawn applications and games may expose no controls.
Only part of this window could be read. The scan is limited to 256 controls and 12 levels. Other controls may be available through Windows keys.
